text_en: Then David said, “Here shall be the house of the Lord God and here the altar of burnt offering for Israel. ”
text_cn: 达味遂说：“这里就是上主天主的殿，这里就是以色列献全燔祭的祭坛。”

text_en: David gave orders to gather together the aliens who were residing in the land of Israel, and he set stonecutters to prepare dressed stones for building the house of God.
text_cn: 达味下令招募在以色列境内的外方人， 派石匠开凿石头，为建造天主的殿：

text_en: David also provided great stores of iron for nails for the doors of the gates and for clamps, as well as bronze in quantities beyond weighing,
text_cn: 达味准备了大量的铁，做门扇的钉子和钩子；又准备了大量的铜，无法衡量；

text_en: and cedar logs without number—for the Sidonians and Tyrians brought great quantities of cedar to David.
text_cn: 香柏木不可胜数，因为漆冬和提洛人给达味运来了无数的香柏木。

text_en: For David said, “My son Solomon is young and inexperienced, and the house that is to be built for the Lord must be exceedingly magnificent, famous and glorified throughout all lands; I will therefore make preparation for it. ” So David provided materials in great quantity before his death.
text_cn: 达味曾想：“我儿撒罗满年幼脆弱； 为上主要建造的殿宇，必须极其辉煌，声誉荣耀应传遍万邦，所以我必须为他预备一切。”因此，达味在未死以前，预备了许多建筑材料。

text_en: Then he called for his son Solomon and charged him to build a house for the Lord , the God of Israel.
text_cn: 达味将儿子撒罗满召来，嘱咐他为上主以色列的天主建筑殿宇。

text_en: David said to Solomon, “My son, I had planned to build a house to the name of the Lord my God.
text_cn: 达味对撒罗满说：“我儿，我心里原想为上主我的天主的名，建筑一座殿宇；

text_en: But the word of the Lord came to me, saying, ‘You have shed much blood and have waged great wars; you shall not build a house to my name, because you have shed so much blood in my sight on the earth.
text_cn: 无奈有上主的话传于我说：你流了许多血，屡经大战，你不可为我的名建造殿宇，因为你在我面前往地上流了许多血。

text_en: See, a son shall be born to you; he shall be a man of peace. I will give him peace from all his enemies on every side; for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quiet to Israel in his days.
text_cn: 看，你将生一个儿子，他是一个和平的人，我要使他安宁，不受四周一切仇敌的侵扰，因为他的名字要叫撒罗满；他在位时，我要将和平与安宁赐予以色列。

text_en: He shall build a house for my name. He shall be a son to me, and I will be a father to him, and I will establish his royal throne in Israel forever. ’
text_cn: 他将为我名建造殿宇，他将做我的儿子，我将做他的父亲。我必巩固他的王位，治理以色列，直到永远。

text_en: Now, my son, the Lord be with you, so that you may succeed in building the house of the Lord your God, as he has spoken concerning you.
text_cn: 我儿，如今，愿上主与你同在，使你成功，为上主你的天主建造殿宇，有如他论及你所说的话。

text_en: Only, may the Lord grant you discretion and understanding, so that when he gives you charge over Israel you may keep the law of the Lord your God.
text_cn: 唯愿上主赐给你智慧和聪明，使你治理以色列时，遵循上主你的天主的法律。

text_en: Then you will prosper if you are careful to observe the statutes and the ordinances that the Lord commanded Moses for Israel. Be strong and of good courage. Do not be afraid or dismayed.
text_cn: 如果你谨守遵行上主藉梅瑟吩咐以色列的法律和典章，你必会成功；要有胆量，有勇气，不必畏惧，不必惊惶。

text_en: With great pains I have provided for the house of the Lord one hundred thousand talents of gold, one million talents of silver, and bronze and iron beyond weighing, for there is so much of it; timber and stone too I have provided. To these you must add more.
text_cn: 你看，我辛辛苦苦为上主的殿宇，预备了十万‘塔冷通’的金子，一百万‘塔冷通’的银子，铜和铁多得不可衡量；又预备了木料和石头，你还可以补充。

text_en: You have an abundance of workers: stonecutters, masons, carpenters, and all kinds of artisans without number, skilled in working
text_cn: 并且在你身边还有许多工匠、凿匠、石匠、木匠，以及各种工艺的技术工人。

text_en: gold, silver, bronze, and iron. Now begin the work, and the Lord be with you. ”
text_cn: 关于金银铜铁，多得无数。起来兴工罢！愿上主与你同在！”

text_en: David also commanded all the leaders of Israel to help his son Solomon, saying,
text_cn: 达味又吩咐以色列的领袖协助自己的儿子撒罗满说：

text_en: “Is not the Lord your God with you? Has he not given you peace on every side? For he has delivered the inhabitants of the land into my hand; and the land is subdued before the Lord and his people.
text_cn: “上主，你们的天主不是与你们同在吗？他不是使你们四周都安宁了吗？他已将这地的居民交于我手中，这地已在上主和他的百姓面前归服了；

text_en: Now set your mind and heart to seek the Lord your God. Go and build the sanctuary of the Lord God so that the ark of the covenant of the Lord and the holy vessels of God may be brought into a house built for the name of the Lord . ”
text_cn: 所以现在你们要专心致志，寻求上主你们的天主。起来！兴工建造上主天主的圣所，将上主的约柜和天主的圣器，运入为上主的名所建造的殿宇内。”
